integrity: The statement is proved from explicit pair-subsequence counting and a one-vertex adjacent-exchange argument; finite checker supports but does not substitute for the unlimited proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Positive composition on at least three occurring symbols, indexed rotations, scattered subsequences of length at most two. No theorem for two-letter support, higher binomial order, or multiplicity counts for every class count; historical priority not certified.
title: Sharp \(2\)-binomial rotation spectra for fixed multiletter content
